scope: Mobile Web; wide Web retains ViewportContent; narrow embedded desktop remote workspaces retain their existing rendering strategy; native FlatList is unchanged.

implementation.window: Rich message subtrees unmount outside the actual scroll viewport plus 400px overscan. Every loaded row keeps a lightweight shell and measured height.
implementation.anchors: Explicit following state and message anchors cover deferred measurements, pagination, stream updates, disclosure expansion, image decoding, bottom jumps and viewport changes.
implementation.interaction: Expanded details survive recycling. Focused or selected content and the row owning an open dialog stay mounted until interaction ends.
implementation.memoFixture: The chatRendering test explicitly disables IntersectionObserver to isolate update-phase memo counts; strict historical=0 and active=40 assertions remain unchanged. Browser tests exercise asynchronous viewport admission.

verification.skipReason: Viewport-specific scenarios run in the applicable project only.
verification.coverage: Real ChatMessages via repository display harness: pagination, row identity/order, reading anchors, streaming, bottom jumps, disclosure recycling, selection, image preview, delayed image sizing, height/width changes, mobile/wide breakpoint transitions; existing display, touch, scroll and rendering regressions.

verification.purpose: Native scroll/pagination reference; no native implementation changes.

measurement.method: Bundled Chromium through scripts/test-browser.mjs, Windows host, Vite development display harness with production UI components, mobile viewport 390x844. Initial 60 mixed Markdown/code/math messages plus four pages of 60. CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage then Runtime.getHeapUsage. MutationObserver tracks peak mounted .chat-markdown nodes. Sixty requestAnimationFrame scroll steps (30 forward, 30 backward).
measurement.baseline: Captured immediately before mobile window integration on the current shared renderer. HISTORY_WINDOW_BASELINE=1 only relaxes window assertions and selects before evidence filenames; obtaining a new baseline requires the unwindowed implementation.

limits: The content window bounds mounted rich subtrees, not total DOM, loaded message data or total memory. Lightweight row shells and retained history still grow with loaded history.
GC heap measurements are JavaScript heap only, not browser process memory. This is a single host-development run with concurrent workspace activity.
Frame timings do not establish a significant scrolling-speed improvement or quantify real-device jank.
Screenshots use the running repository display harness with deterministic data, not a live backend/account.
No physical Android/iOS browser, native app, actual OS keyboard, or Tauri local/remote shell was visually exercised by this task. Native behavior was inspected and its 32 reference tests passed.
Build OOM history does not establish a runtime memory leak or a Mermaid cause.
